svg.text: Gaussian noise: every point gets a bell centred on the line
Model y = w·x + noise, noise ~ Normal(0, 1). Orange bar = bell height at the real point = that point's likelihood factor.

g.text: best w: highest likelihood = lowest MSE

svg.text: A point far from the line sits in the bell's thin tail: its factor is tiny, and the product (the likelihood) collapses.
